title: Detect installed agent CLIs and register them ready-to-run
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Find claude, codex, cursor-agent, gemini, aider, openhands, opencode and friends, run their doctor checks and mark them ready without 'susi agents configure'. Tests zc_agent_autodetect_*.
